notes: A waltz-like tide in 3/4: up by step from the home note to the fifth, held across the bar, then down past the start to the leading note. Plain and singable; the held note is the high water. Autumn: E Dorian, lower and rounder; the answer puts the theme in the bass on the cello under a high held line.
